# Anonymous correspondence and adjudication

You are a fresh independent AI correspondence/adjudication role. The complete
first-cause and alarm record barriers must verify before this phase. You receive
five anonymous cases, each with I (common initial source) and X/Y (two final
sources), their exact source/contracts/native facts/PNG inputs, unchanged source
contract supplements, and both original sealed cause and alarm judgments. You
must not access the separate X/Y assignment, tool identity, cost, operator parent
directories, SDKs, another case's worker context, or editable production trees.

Verify every supplied input seal and member before use. A seal is a record of
judgment, not proof that its propositions are true. Preserve original judgments
and appendices. Do not infer intended treatment, demand a defect denominator,
infer a pass from an expected value, or overwrite a disagreeing first judgment.

For every case, perform the following evidence-based correspondence:

1. Identify confirmed genuine initial causes and current causes in X/Y. Match
   actual source/native/image/approved-contract evidence, retaining both judges'
   identifiers and any corrections. Repeated states, reports, atomic assertion
   rows, or screenshots do not multiply a cause. Separate iOS and Android unless
   positive common source/design-interpretation evidence supports one cause.
   Similar symptoms or identical wording alone do not establish a common cause.
2. For every confirmed initial cause, give exactly one X and one Y relation:
   `present`, `removed`, or `unresolved`, with concrete original evidence. A
   source edit, green automatic row, or absent alarm alone does not prove removal.
   Also identify confirmed new regressions and unresolved possible regressions.
3. Reconcile deduplicated product-defect alarms by their original proposition,
   source version, platform, original document/pointer and state. Adjudicate
   `true`, `false`, or `unresolved`. Keep measurement limits, missing evidence,
   infrastructure/SDK failures and pending work separately. Keep false positive
   validation/pass claims separate from false product-defect alarms. Record all
   unresolved claims and the original independent disagreements.
4. Preserve visibility: an alarm from the original own public repair loop may
   establish worker detection; a post-self-seal private validation alarm cannot.
   Mark `worker_visible` explicitly and cite the neutral material manifest's
   original episode classification. Also retain each original source-version
   identity. Do not attribute a private oracle or a later judge appendix to the
   worker. Common I alarms are shared research, not either final arm's success.
5. Record attempted repairs only with original worker statement/patch/handoff
   evidence. Link genuine initial cause IDs separately from measurement or
   observability work. Deduplicate repeated attempts on one cause. Resolution
   and detection are separate; an incidentally removed cause remains removed
   without receiving detection credit.

Retain a complete decision ledger for agreements, adjudicated disagreements and
unresolved disagreements. For an adjudicated disagreement, cite your actual raw
source/native/image inspection and explain why it resolves the proposition.
Unresolved required quality prevents complete delivery. Do not force consensus.

For later frozen source/image evaluation, output a separate actual-only
consensus file for every group (I/X/Y):

- Source observations: all original public/private × iOS/Android claim IDs.
  Preserve actual Boolean/null, original subject source citations and lines,
  original judge refs, agreement/adjudication basis and original uncertainty.
  A normative API document is a specification, not an implementation citation.
  Do not invent a production citation from an external document. Missing valid
  actual subject evidence remains unknown at binding.
- Private image observations: retain the exact template's observation ID,
  platform, catalog SHA, original observation SHA, every visual review ID,
  actual Boolean/null, rationale and exact allowed original frame indices.
  Native pixel measurements are rebuilt by the frozen evaluator; do not replace
  them with a visual guess. A true full-content proposition requires actual
  complete content evidence. PNG aliases require exact SHA proof and separate
  state/epoch bindings.
- Record all conflicting original actuals, frame/citation errors, unsupported
  methods and uninspected facts. A mere majority or expected value cannot fill
  an actual. Original judgments and attempted invalid bindings remain retained.

The anonymous cause/alarm correspondence output uses this structural schema
(case IDs and cause/alarm/repair IDs must be unique in their stated scope):

```json
{
  "version": 1,
  "kind": "independent-anonymous-five-case-correspondence",
  "input_seals_verified": [],
  "cases": [
    {
      "case_id": "Case01",
      "confirmed_initial_causes": [],
      "unresolved_initial_suspicions": [],
      "versions": {
        "X": {
          "initial_relations": [],
          "defect_alarms": [],
          "positive_validation_claims": [],
          "measurement_infrastructure_and_work_items": [],
          "attempted_repairs": [],
          "new_regressions": [],
          "unresolved_regressions": [],
          "unresolved_quality": [],
          "independent_quality_complete": false
        },
        "Y": {}
      }
    }
  ],
  "agreements_and_disagreements": [],
  "images_and_original_evidence_inspected": [],
  "scope_limits": []
}
```

Each `initial_relations` row needs `initial_cause_id`, `status`, and nonempty
`evidence`. Each defect-alarm row needs `id`, `verdict`, `worker_visible`,
`source_version`, original document/pointer and nonempty `evidence`; only a true
alarm can link `initial_cause_ids`. Each attempted repair needs `id`, actual
`evidence`, and `initial_cause_ids`. Each confirmed regression needs `id` and
actual `evidence`. Positive validation claims need their own `id`, `verdict`,
visibility and evidence. Populate both X/Y fully for all five cases. Do not add
cost values or compute treatment metrics here.

Write the actual-only group consensus files and inspection/disagreement ledger
alongside `correspondence.json`. Seal every regular output member readonly in
`SEAL.json`, with version 1, kind `independent-anonymous-correspondence-seal`,
and the exact `{relative_file: SHA256}` inventory excluding SEAL.json. No symlink
outputs. Return seal path/SHA and coverage only. All correspondence and actual
consensus decisions must seal before X/Y assignment reveal. Root then performs
mechanical source/image binding, frozen evaluator replay, cost joining and fixed
metric arithmetic; these later steps cannot rewrite your judgments.
